INFANT 1

3–4 months: colour, objects and reaching.

The Infant 1 class. Around this age many babies start to notice colour and reach toward what interests them, so this lesson pairs strong single colours with familiar objects.

Age 3–4 MonthsClass Infant 1Subjects Vision, movement, communication
Lesson 3See

Colors & First Objects

Bold red, yellow and blue alongside familiar objects — a ball, a cup, a spoon, a teddy. Name them if you like; there is nothing to test.
